service.description: The identities the user may send as: each identity of an account the user may send from ({value identity:id or account:id, label, emailAccountId, emailIdentityId, emailAddress, displayName, accountName, signatureHtml, signaturePlacementEnumId, useForReplies, isDefault}). defaultValue is the default identity of MAIL_DEFAULT_ACCOUNT when that account is one the user may send from, else the default identity of the first account.

What the composer starts with. A draft (emailMessageId, one the user may send from): its identity, recipients, subject, body (its quoted part apart), attachments and the message it answers. A reply (replyToEmailMessageId, a message the user reads; replyAll for every recipient but the user) or a forward (forwardEmailMessageId: a draft made now, with copies of the files): the account it came to, the sender (its Reply-To) and recipients, "Re:" or "Fwd:" and the quoted message. A new message takes to, cc, bcc, subject and body (mailto style), and the record chip recordEntity, recordId when a record-lookup provider answers for it. Each recipient is {value, label, kind (address), locked}. An internal message or a mailbox post is an app's (its inbox-source answers this operation).

The recipients the To, Cc and Bcc chips offer for the term: the users of this system (by name or address) and the addresses of the user's recent mail, then what was typed when it is an address. Options {value, label, kind address}: value is the address as a header ("Name" <address>). The people, contact groups and mailboxes of an app's contact books are its own (its inbox-source answers this operation).

The chips of a recipient field ([{value, label}] or their JSON) for a send: the header text of the address chips. Another kind of chip (a person, group or mailbox of an app's) is refused here; an entry that is not an address is an error naming it.

Save an email draft (org.moqui.impl.EmailClientServices.save#Draft) from the composer: the identity (fromValue identity:id or account:id of an account the user may send from), the recipient chips, subject and body, with the quoted part of a reply or forward after the body, and for a new draft the message it answers or forwards. Its attachments stay as upload#ComposeAttachment and remove#ComposeAttachment keep them. clientRef, the client's own reference of the draft, makes a retry save the same draft (save#Draft): a draft written offline is saved once, and one sent since comes back unchanged with duplicate true. baseStamp, the draftStamp of the copy the client edited (get#ComposeData, or the last save), keeps a draft saved elsewhere since: nothing is saved, conflict is true and compose is the server's draft as get#ComposeData has it (the client keeps its own as a copy, a new draft with a new clientRef). draftStamp is the saved draft's.

parameter.name: strict
parameter.description: A recipient that is not an address is an error (for a send); a draft keeps only those that are

service.description: A draft (ES_DRAFT, or a failed send) of an account the user may send from; an error otherwise.

Files for the composer. For an email draft (emailMessageId) each file is stored as the mail client stores a message's files (dbresource://email/account/message/), and the draft's attachments become its own plus these. Without a draft (an internal message) each file is stored under the user's own folder (dbresource://comms/compose/user/) for send#Compose to put on the message. Files over 25 MB are refused. clientRef in place of emailMessageId names the user's draft that save#ComposeDraft saved with it (a client that queued the mail offline). With clientRef a file of the same name and size as one the draft has is not added again, so a retry after a lost answer attaches it once (two equal files are not attached this way); when the message of the clientRef is no longer a draft (sent since), its attachmentList comes back and nothing is added. uploadId in place of contentFile is a file the client sent in chunks (ClientSyncServices.upload#Chunk), complete, of the user's own.

Attach from Files (design-drawers-commons.md §12 AttachFromFiles): the drive files the user picked (itemList of {driveId, path}), each read through FileServices.get#ResourceInfo as the user (records too), so only a file the user may open is used. For an email draft (emailMessageId) each is copied where the mail client keeps a message's files (dbresource://email/account/message/, the only place save#Draft takes a file from) and added to the draft's attachments; without a draft (an internal message) each is copied under the user's compose folder for send#Compose. A file over maxAttachBytes (25 MB by default) or a folder is not copied: a view link is made for it (FileServices.share#Resource, which needs the user to be allowed to share it) and linkList gives its name and linkPath to put in the message. Each item stands alone: one that fails is named in failedList.
Take a file off an email draft (emailMessageAttachmentId of a draft the user may send from); its file is deleted when the draft keeps it under dbresource://email/.

Send what the composer has: the draft is saved (strict about recipients), then sent through org.moqui.impl.EmailClientServices.send#Draft: at scheduledSendDate, or now after the undo hold of holdSeconds (0 to 300). archiveThread archives the thread answered (Send and archive). An internal message, and filing the mail on a record, are an app's (its inbox-source answers this operation).
clientRef is the client's own reference of the message (save#ComposeDraft), so a client that queued it offline and retries after a lost answer sends it once: when the user's message of that clientRef is already waiting to send (the undo hold or a scheduled send), sending, sent, or failed (a send that failed may have gone out; the user sends it again), its state comes back (EmailClientServices.get#SendState) with duplicate true and nothing is done. After an undo (cancel#ComposeSend) it is a draft again and a send with the clientRef sends it. baseStamp is as save#ComposeDraft has it: a draft saved elsewhere since the client's copy is not sent (conflict true, with compose, the server's draft).
Undo send. An email waiting in the Outbox (the undo hold or a scheduled send) goes back to Drafts (org.moqui.impl.EmailClientServices.cancel#ScheduledSend); one sent already cannot come back.
Discard an email draft of the user's (org.moqui.impl.EmailClientServices.trash#Messages deletes a draft, its files and its copy on an IMAP server). An internal message has no draft on the server.
